domain-information: As a user, I want to enter my zip code and see nearby recycling centers so that I can easily find where to drop off my waste.
As a user, I want to view what materials each center accepts so that I don’t bring items they can’t handle.
As a user, I want to check each center’s opening hours so that I can plan my drop-offs conveniently.
As a user, I want to view centers on a map so that I can visualize which are closest to my location.
As a user, I want to save my preferred recycling centers so that I can access them quickly next time.
As a user, I want to see if centers are currently open or closed so that I don’t waste time driving there.
As a user, I want to see public recycling bins and special drop-off sites around me so that I know all disposal options.
As a user, I want to view upcoming community recycling or safe disposal events so that I can take part in them.
As a user, I want to subscribe for notifications about new events or collection days so that I stay informed.
As a user, I want to filter centers by material type or environmental certification so that I can recycle responsibly.
As a user, I want to get route suggestions based on my saved centers so that I can plan efficient recycling trips.
As a user, I want to give feedback about a center or report incorrect information so that others benefit from accurate data.
As an administrator, I want to add, update, or remove recycling center information so that users always see up-to-date details.
As an administrator, I want to view user feedback and usage data so that I can identify issues and improve services.
As an administrator, I want to communicate directly with facility representatives so that I can coordinate updates efficiently.
As an administrator, I want to monitor recycling activity by area so that I can understand participation across regions.
As an administrator, I want to review requests from new facilities to join the platform so that I can expand coverage.
As a facility representative, I want to update what materials we accept so that users know what can be brought in.
As a facility representative, I want to view upcoming user drop-offs so that I can plan staff and equipment needs.
As a facility representative, I want to contact administrators directly so that I can resolve issues quickly.
As a facility representative, I want to share data about collected materials so that environmental impact can be tracked.
As a company partner, I want to see aggregate data about recycling volumes so that I can evaluate sustainability efforts.
As a community member, I want to suggest new drop-off locations so that recycling becomes easier for everyone.
As a researcher, I want to access anonymized recycling statistics so that I can study community recycling behavior.
As a user, I want to see how much waste I’ve diverted over time so that I can track my personal environmental impact.
